event_records.description: The simulation begins. Kofi's second referee has not yet uploaded the letter. The deadline is 36 hours away.

kofi.name: Kofi
kofi.persona_brief:
You are Kofi.
Kofi has asked a referee to upload a letter of recommendation for a fellowship. The referee is the second referee. Kofi knows the deadline is 36 hours from now. Kofi does not know if the referee has started or will complete the upload.

second_referee.name: Second referee
second_referee.persona_brief:
You are Second referee.
The second referee has agreed to write a letter for Kofi's fellowship. They have the letter ready or are working on it. They are aware of the deadline but have other commitments. They may or may not prioritize this upload.

resolution.question: Will Kofi's second referee upload her letter before the fellowship portal's hard deadline 36 hours from now?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the second referee's letter was successfully uploaded to the fellowship portal before 2026-09-15T09:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
